items.exampleEn: Spiders weave their webs at night.
The worker tightened every bolt on the bridge.
items.exampleZh: 工人把橋上的每一顆螺栓都鎖緊了。

items.exampleEn: She knelt down to tie her son's shoes.
items.exampleZh: 她跪下來幫兒子綁鞋帶。

items.exampleEn: She extracted a small key from the bottom of her bag.
items.exampleZh: 她從包包底部取出一把小鑰匙。

items.exampleEn: The thief surrendered to the police at the train station.
items.exampleZh: 那名小偷在火車站向警方投案。

items.exampleEn: A helicopter hovered above the stadium during the game.
items.exampleZh: 比賽期間，一架直升機在體育場上空盤旋。

items.exampleEn: Scientists strive to find cleaner sources of energy.
items.exampleZh: 科學家努力尋找更乾淨的能源。

items.exampleEn: The garden was full of weeds after years of neglect.
items.exampleZh: 經過多年的疏於照顧，花園裡長滿了雜草。

items.sentenceEn: A bee hovered over the flowers for a few seconds.
items.sentenceZh: 一隻蜜蜂在花上盤旋了幾秒鐘。

items.audioEn: The chess player surrendered after losing his queen on the twentieth move.
items.audioZh: 那位棋手在第二十步失去皇后之後就認輸了。
items.questionZh: 那位棋手什麼時候認輸？
options: At the very end of the day

items.sentenceEn: The horse bolted when it heard the thunder.
items.sentenceZh: 那匹馬聽到雷聲就突然狂奔。

items.sentenceEn: Neglect of the old bridge made it unsafe to cross.
items.sentenceZh: 那座舊橋因為疏於維護，已經不能安全通行。

items.stemEn: Everyone had to ____ on the floor to look under the bed.
items.stemZh: 每個人都得跪在地上看床底下。

items.stemEn: Factories ____ oil from these seeds to make soap.
items.stemZh: 工廠從這些種子中提取油來製作肥皂。

items.passageEn: My grandmother's village is famous for its baskets. Each one is woven so tightly that it can even hold water. For many years, this handicraft suffered from neglect, because young people moved to the city. Now, a small group of villagers strives to keep the tradition alive. They teach classes in an old barn, where the door is closed with a heavy wooden bolt. Last summer, I knelt beside my grandmother on the barn floor and learned to make my first basket.
items.passageZh: 我祖母的村子以籃子聞名。每個籃子都編得非常緊密，甚至可以裝水。多年來，這項手工藝因為年輕人搬到城市而乏人問津。現在，一小群村民努力讓這項傳統延續下去。他們在一座舊穀倉裡開課，穀倉的門用一根沉重的木門閂關上。去年夏天，我跪在穀倉地板上、祖母的身旁，學會編我的第一個籃子。

questions.questionZh: 這項手工藝為什麼曾經乏人問津？

items.promptZh: 我們努力讓每一位顧客都滿意。
referenceEn: We strive to make every customer happy.
We strive to keep all our customers satisfied.
rubricZh: 要用 strive to＋原形動詞（例如 strive to make）

items.promptZh: 入場前，請把你的手機交給工作人員。
referenceEn: Please surrender your phone to the staff before you go in.
Before entering, please surrender your phones to the staff.
rubricZh: surrender 在這裡表示「交出」，例如 surrender your phone to the staff 等
「入場前」可寫，例如 before you go in、before entering 等，句首句尾都可以
